text:
rachel: dropped a small design pass called 'lunar gamut' in Figma (frames 5-8). main asks: legend truncation on narrow widths, prediction-range rendering on charts, inline code caret contrast, and exact theme switch wording. link: https://figma.com/file/lunar-gamut-preview

omar: nice frames. legend truncation is the big one — when label lengths vary the trailing ellipsis hides the metric unit (e.g., 'latency p50 (ms)'). propose: show full label on hover + make the dot + label a single focus target for keyboard users.

neil: prediction ranges: currently we render a solid pale band which hides gridlines when opaque. recommend rendering range as a 20% alpha fill + dashed outline for the band edge so it's distinguishable but grid remains visible. also for estimated data use a dashed series stroke. small sketch attached in Figma.

sophia: caret contrast: caret uses --code-caret: #4fc3ff on top of code-bg #0e141a. contrast dips when caret overlaps punctuation. make caret #aef6ff and increase caret width to 2px for visibility. also suggest inline code use font-weight 500.

rachel: love the dashed outline idea. @design-bot can we add a CSS token for prediction-outline: --series-pred-outline: rgba(174,246,255,0.9)? and a token for dashed-gap: 6 4?

design-bot: token proposal created in branch feat/lunar-gamut-tokens: --series-pred-fill: rgba(47,183,255,0.12); --series-pred-outline: rgba(174,246,255,0.88); --chart-dash: 6 4. PR: https://git.redwood/console/pulls/428.

omar: accessibility: for legend focus target please also expose aria-describedby pointing to full metric name. that way screen readers read "request latency p50 (milliseconds)" not just "p50".

neil: on theming copy: i've seen confusion when toggle only says "Dark"/"Light". propose final label: "Theme: Follow system / Light / Dark / High contrast" and add an aria-label: "Theme preference; when Follow system is chosen the UI matches your OS setting". feel free to shorten to "System" if space is tight but prefer explicit.

sophia: colorblind-safe palette suggestion for the lunar set: primary #2fb7ff, accent #ff9f6b (warm), warn #ff6b8a. overlapping areas of primary+accent become a readable coral rather than muddy brown. also add pattern option (diagonal stripes) for exports in grayscale.

rachel: small copy tweak: chart tooltip should append "(sampled)" when value is sampled and "(est.)" when estimated. keeps support tickets down.

design-bot: deploy preview: https://deploy.preview/redwood-console/feat/lunar-gamut (expires 48h). automated axe results: 6 warnings, 1 violation (legend focus color needs stronger contrast in compact list). Details in PR comments.

omar: i'll push a quick CSS change: --focus-ring: 2px solid rgba(174,246,255,0.92) on compact legend focus and test with keyboard-only nav.

neil: i'll review the preview and post screenshots of dashed ranges vs solid band.

sophia: quick mock note: when prediction range overlaps a data point, show a small outline halo on the point so it remains hittable.

rachel: thanks all. plan: land tokens + toggle copy + dashed ranges this sprint if contrast fix is green. please leave final thumbs by EOD. :rocket:
